proves.claim: with parallel on, landingOfferBatches returns one single-item batch per id of the first start group, so disjoint items are offered together and items sharing a file or test are not

cli.io-landing-pull.parallel-on-offers-g.why: Without it the lander could offer two items that touch the same file or test together.

proves.claim: with parallel off, landingOfferBatches cuts free into batches of size exactly as the slice loop on main does

cli.io-landing-pull.parallel-off-as-toda.why: Without it turning the setting off could change how offers are batched today.
